cards.name: Gyakutenno Megami
cards.description: Uses her mystical power to protect the weak and provide spiritual support.

cards.name: Goddess with the Third Eye
cards.description: A goddess with an all-seeing eye that reveals all.

cards.name: Doma The Angel of Silence
cards.description: This angel rules over the doomed and administers it when necessary.

cards.name: Orion the Battle King
cards.description: A mysterious creature known as the king of warriors, but nobody has lived to tell how it earned its reputation.

cards.name: Weather Control
cards.description: This monster is capable of manipulating the weather. This power is the reason behind the changing climate of mountains.

cards.name: Mystical Capture Chain
cards.description: A mystical chain that is believed capable of binding its enemies and preventing their attacks.

cards.name: Spirit of the Harp
cards.description: A spirit that soothes the soul with music of its glorious harp.

cards.name: Key Mace
cards.description: A small angel whose cuteness melts the hearts of its enemies.

cards.name: Happy Lover
cards.description: A little angel that fires beams of happiness from the heart jewel on its forehead.

cards.name: Petit Angel
cards.description: A quick-moving and tiny angel that's very difficult to hit.

cards.name: Hourglass of Life
cards.description: A creature that allows power to be gained at the cost of life.

cards.name: Lunar Queen Elzaim
cards.description: A lovely moon goddess that can throw up a lunar curtain to block attacks.

cards.name: Wing Egg Elf
cards.description: Hiding within is eggshell, this creature blocks enemy attacks with its massive wings.

cards.name: Ray & Temperature
cards.description: The Sun and the North Wind join hands to deliver a devastating combination of heat and gale-force winds.

cards.name: Dancing Elf
cards.description: An elf that dances across the sky with wings of razor-sharp blades.

cards.name: Ocubeam
cards.description: Frightening in appearance, this creature uses its large eyes and ears to keep track of any movement.

cards.name: Goddess of Whim
cards.description: A shy goddess that seems to spend the majority of her time sleeping.

cards.name: Hoshiningen
cards.description: Trailed by a beautiful tail, this shooting star inflicts damage when it hits an enemy.

cards.name: Skelengel
cards.description: A phantom fairy that fires countless arrows at anything that harbors an urge to attack.

cards.name: Dark Witch
cards.description: A popular creature in mythology that delivers judgment with a sharp spear.

cards.name: Binding Chain
cards.description: This creature corners its enemies and seals away their power.

cards.name: Muse-A
cards.description: A fairy of the arts and an excellent harp player.

cards.name: Tenderness
cards.description: A cute fairy dedicated to bringing about eternal love.

cards.name: Shining Friendship
cards.description: The peacemaker among monsters.

cards.name: Hourglass of Courage
cards.description: A fairy that controls the feelings of others, instilling them with bravery.

cards.name: Winged Egg of New Life
cards.description: A messenger of newborn life.
